title: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing the issuance of $115 million aggregate principal amount of 0% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 by its wholly-owned subsidiary HIVE Bermuda 2026 Ltd. The company simultaneously entered into capped call transactions with financial institutions to hedge against potential dilution upon note exchange.
key_points: HIVE Bermuda 2026 Ltd. (wholly-owned subsidiary) issued $115 million of 0% exchangeable senior notes due April 15, 2031, including full exercise of $15 million option.
Initial exchange rate: 389.5029 common shares per $1,000 principal (equivalent to ~$2.57/share, a 17.5% premium over April 16, 2026 closing price).
Notes are general unsecured obligations; HIVE Digital's guarantee is senior unsecured.
Issuer may redeem notes early on or after April 20, 2029 if share price is at least 130% of exchange price for 20 trading days.
Holders may require cash repurchase on April 15, 2029 at principal amount.
Company entered capped call transactions on April 16 and 17, 2026 to reduce potential dilution from note exchanges.
